title: TaggedText
description: A run of language data (gameplan §6.1). `tokens` concatenate, in logical order, to the NFC surface text. Language data is never a bare string and never addressed by character offsets.
$comment: v0 (Phase 0). Invariants a JSON Schema cannot express, checked by @nabu/core and the compiler: every string is NFC; token surfaces never split a grapheme cluster; ruby bases concatenate to their token's surface; morph surfaces concatenate to their token's surface; `lang` falls within the orthography's language.

surface.description: NFC. Never splits a grapheme cluster.

sense.description: Link to the lexicon (a knowledge component).

readings.description: Readings per scheme, e.g. {"jyutping": "hong4"}. Pinned in content, never guessed at runtime.

ruby.description: Per-base annotation for each scheme. The bases of each array concatenate to `surface`.

ipa.description: SURFACE pronunciation, after sandhi and changed tones (§10.4).

tileGroup.description: Tokens with the same group form one word-bank tile.

variants.description: Accepted orthographic variants, e.g. HK and TW character forms.

morphs.description: Agglutinative breakdown. Morph surfaces concatenate to `surface`.

RubySegment.title: RubySegment
RubySegment.description: One ruby base and its annotation. Sub-token annotation always uses segments, never integer offsets.
